_comment: Idempotent push manifest. The Guardian writes this as it pushes, persisting EACH entry immediately after a successful create + read-back (per-post, not at the end). On re-run it is read first; any post whose key already has a postId is skipped (--resume). See guides/05-idempotency-manifest.md.

entries.key: <deterministic hash(provider + locationId + accountIds + summary + media + scheduleDate)>
entries.postId: <real id: GHL results.post._id | Zernio /posts id. null until created>

readBack.failureReason: <null, or the exact publish-time failure from the read-back GET>
